negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'NABU (Independent Association of Banks of Ukraine)'. Multiple uk sources (Interfax-Ukraine, Ekonomichna Pravda, borgexpert) report that Незалежна асоціація банків України renamed itself to Національна асоціація банків України — nabu.ua now presents the National name while many page titles and inbound links still carry the Independent one.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both names are in live use across the same domain; the acronym НАБУ is unchanged.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity resolution will fragment if the collector treats the two names as different organisations. Worse, НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (also НАБУ), the dominant sense in uk search — an uncontrolled keyword feed on 'НАБУ' will be overwhelmingly anti-corruption news noise.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of https://nabu.ua/ua/struktura-nabu.html returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the first attempt during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No content retrieved; page content is nonetheless well indexed by search, indicating the site is live and bot-throttled rather than down.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis of throttling, not a dead source. A collector must rate-limit nabu.ua aggressively; a naive crawler will get itself banned from the single most important source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of https://fintechua.org/about returned essentially empty content ('..'), indicating client-side rendering.
negative_findings.result_summary: UAFIC board and member data are not in the served HTML.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The fintech-side association — one of the four named in the cell pointer — cannot be collected with plain HTTP fetching. A headless browser stage is required, or the data must be sourced indirectly (trade media, registry).

negative_findings.description: aub.org.ua serves the same content under both legacy /index.php/pro-asotsiatsiiu/... and clean /working-body/... paths, and a fetch of https://aub.org.ua/pro-asotsiatsiiu/rada-aub returned an archived news article from May 2004 rather than the current council roster.
negative_findings.result_summary: Current AUB council composition was not retrieved in this pass; only the presidency was corroborated from search (Andrii Bohdanovych, as of Dec 2025).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A diff-based collector pointed at the wrong AUB path will silently monitor a 2004 archive page and report 'no change' forever. Path selection must be validated manually before the source is trusted.

negative_findings.description: Targeted uk search for a named Board Chair (Голова Ради) of the EMA association returned the board page URL and the 24 Oct 2025 General Assembly member-institution list, but no chair name in the search excerpt.
negative_findings.result_summary: EMA board composition at institution level is evidenced; the individual chair is not, from search alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments-side chair is a high-value data point; it requires a direct render of https://www.ema.com.ua/about/board/ rather than search-derived extraction. Note also that EMA's board is composed of institutions (Mastercard, Visa, banks), so person-level extraction needs the delegate names on the page itself.

negative_findings.description: No EBA Ukraine banking/financial-services committee chair election was found; the committee-election pattern was only confirmed on the Ukraine Recovery Committee (chair elected 19 Dec 2025).
negative_findings.result_summary: The mechanism is confirmed for EBA generally; the specific financial-sector committee page URL remains unlocated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: EBA is scored on an inferred pattern rather than a verified banking-committee page — its confidence is correspondingly lower and it needs a directed crawl of the EBA committees index before being promoted.

negative_findings.description: For the Ukrainian Credit-Banking Union (UKBS), indexed material and membership figures trace to 2014 or earlier, and two competing domains appeared (ukbs.org.ua, kbs.org.ua). No current council or president was found in either uk search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Organisation exists in the state register (EDRPOU 21573585) but current web activity is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Spending collection budget on a dormant association is waste; conversely, recording it as dead on this evidence would be premature. Needs a manual liveness check, not an automated verdict.

negative_findings.description: No established Ukrainian-language term was found for 'self-regulatory organisation' as applied to the banking and payments sector specifically. 'Саморегулівна організація (СРО)' is a securities-market concept under the NSSMC; banking and payments bodies in Ukraine describe themselves as громадська спілка / асоціація / об'єднання, not СРО.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching 'саморегулівна організація' in a banking/payments context yields credit-union and securities-market results, not banking associations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's framing as 'self-regulatory bodies' does not translate to a productive uk query term for banking/payments. Query design must instead use асоціація / спілка / об'єднання / рада + голова/правління/комітет.

negative_findings.description: No association was found that publishes a job-vacancies or recruitment feed for the sector; the 'jobs/hiring' topic is only weakly served by this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association sources yield appointments and elections, not job postings. The nearest adjacency found was jobs.dou.ua hosting a UAFIC company page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cell #10 should be scoped as a leadership/organisation-change source, with jobs and hiring coverage delegated to job-board and company-careers cells; expecting vacancy data here will produce a false coverage claim.

coverage_gaps.description: UAFIC (fintechua.org) — one of the four associations named in the cell pointer — is client-side rendered and its board/member data were not retrievable in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a headless-browser render stage for fintechua.org (/about, members, news) and re-scout the board, deputy-chair posts and member roster; corroborate against registry EDRPOU 42031209.

coverage_gaps.description: Canonical index URLs for the full member directories of NABU and AUB, and for AUB's committee list, were inferred from site navigation rather than fetched. EMA's members page is the only member directory directly verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a shallow directed crawl of nabu.ua and aub.org.ua to pin exact member-list and committee-list URLs, canonicalising aub.org.ua's duplicate /index.php/ vs clean-path forms before any diffing is configured.

coverage_gaps.description: EMA's board is published at institution level (Mastercard, Visa, PrivatBank, Raiffeisen, Oschadbank, Sens Bank, UkrSibbank, PUMB, Universal Bank, Ukrgasbank, OTP Bank, VST Bank). Delegate names — the actual A5 signal — were not extracted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Render https://www.ema.com.ua/about/board/ directly and confirm whether individual delegates and the Board Chair are named; if not, derive person-level data from EMA event/working-group announcements instead.

coverage_gaps.description: A cross-association Coordination Council of professional financial-market participants (AUB + PFTS + Stock Market Lawyers Association + League of Insurance Organisations and others) was found but not scouted, and its current membership and leadership are unknown. NBU-adjacent consultative bodies (Громадська рада при НБУ, Рада з фінансової стабільності) were likewise only glimpsed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the Coordination Council and the NBU Public Council rosters as a second snowball wave — they aggregate delegates from every sectoral association and would materially extend the actor map at low cost.

coverage_gaps.description: No association covering payment-service providers / e-money issuers as a distinct segment (as opposed to EMA's bank-and-scheme membership) was identified, nor any open-banking or PSP industry body under Ukraine's new payment-services regime.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted uk queries on 'об'єднання надавачів платіжних послуг', 'асоціація емітентів електронних грошей', 'відкритий банкінг об'єднання' and check the NBU payment-infrastructure pages for named industry working groups.

coverage_gaps.description: Association rosters are snapshots with no published change history; the associations' own sites overwrite governance pages on re-election, so prior compositions are lost.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish an archival baseline now (own snapshots plus Wayback captures of the governance URLs) so that the first diffs have something to compare against, and treat General Assembly seasons (EMA's assembly fell in October, NABU's assemblies set 4-year council terms) as scheduled high-yield collection windows.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage in this cell is thin and skewed to the foreign-business chambers (AmCham, EBA, USUBC); the three Ukrainian banking associations publish governance data almost exclusively in uk (NABU also carries a ru locale).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat uk as the primary collection language for this cell and use en sources only for the international-bank segment; ensure the pipeline transliterates and cross-matches uk/en/ru name variants of the same executives.

brief: Ukraine's banking and payments industry-body layer is small, well-defined and unusually rich for A5: three banking associations (NABU/НАБУ — renamed from Independent to National Association of Banks; AUB with ~70 members and a 13-seat Council; the older, possibly dormant UKBS), one payments association (EMA/ЄМА, whose 24 Oct 2025 General Assembly seated a board of Mastercard, Visa and the top Ukrainian banks, and whose verified 70+ member directory is the best actor map for the payments side), one fintech association (UAFIC), plus adjacent bodies for financial companies, credit unions and compliance and the foreign chambers (AmCham, EBA) whose committee co-chairs are serving bank executives. Governance pages and General Assembly / committee-election press releases are the highest-precision feed — they name a person, a title and an employer bank in one dated record — while member directories double as the census of actors worth scouting elsewhere. The main operational risks are technical rather than access-related: nabu.ua rate-limits automated fetches (429), fintechua.org renders client-side, aub.org.ua serves duplicate URL forms with one path resolving to a 2004 archive article, and the acronym НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau, so any keyword-driven feed must be entity-disambiguated. This cell should be scoped to leadership and organisation change; it yields essentially no job-vacancy data.
